$comment: Machine-readable mirror of context-schema.md (the authoritative document). Update both in the same commit. Consumers: context-sync, future check tooling, agents that prefer structured data.
title: .context/ directory schema

core.sync: whole-tree, version-stamped, via context-sync update only

.context/kickoff.md.note: project data; regenerated by a session only when the template materially changes

agents/sessions.md.note: current group's registry; rotated by context-history

agents/roster.md.note: team roster for the current group; one row per person (Name, codename S<NNN>, model, doing); Name and codename each unique; context-mem check enforces; context-history resets on group close

tasks/current.md.note: single-agent lock only; collaboration mode uses event claims

collaboration/events/<event-id>.md.note: one file per peer event; never edit an event

sessions/SUMMARY.md.note: entries are removable; permanent record is agents/sessions.md

sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-N/notes.md.note: per-session detailed notes; disposable — durable facts must be promoted first

workflows/active.md.note: protocol field is recorded 'by agent type', naming BOTH editions — never a single edition

workflows/gates.conf.note: explicit lifecycle commands; hybrid mode may discover conventional commands

overrides/rules.md.precedence: beats the edition, except secret-handling and append-only rules

bindingRules.editionSelection: function of the running agent's type at session start; never read from memory
bindingRules.machineBlocks: apply only where the block's 'Identify by' matches
bindingRules.credentialFlows: agent-type facts; PAT steps exist only in the cloud edition
bindingRules.appendOnly: corrections are appended, never edited in; byte-identical duplicates may be removed with a note
bindingRules.updateInPlace: one entry per key (ai-models.md keyed by Agent+Model, environments.md by its Identify-by line); correct an entry by editing it in place, never by appending a duplicate — the prior value survives in git history; context-mem check flags a duplicated key
bindingRules.oneWayLinkage: memory may reference product code; product code must never reference memory — no ADR number, bug ID, or .context/ path in a product docstring/comment/doc, which would be a dangling pointer for anyone reading only the product repo; context-mem lint flags it in the staged product diff
bindingRules.secrets: values only under memory/secrets/, never in tracked files, never echoed
bindingRules.coreReadOnly: no agent writes under .context/core/ in a project repo, ever
bindingRules.collaboration: peers are one team, not rivals; isolated worktree/branch per agent; the everyday event is an informal note (body-only, non-gating); a release/handoff closes a claim by citing its event ID or by sharing session+issue and overlapping paths; overlapping ACTIVE claims escalate to peers comparing changes and an agreement naming the best-supported option and one owner; no timestamp or agent-ID tie-breaker
bindingRules.collaborationCheck: context-collab check is the integration-readiness gate for malformed events, unresolved overlaps, incomplete agreements, unresolved corrections/handoffs, and releases without product commits; notes never gate it; single-pass so it stays fast on large trails
bindingRules.lifecycleGates: context-gates checkpoint runs before each next agent action; pre-commit, integration, and exit gates block their lifecycle transition on failure; explicit gates.conf commands take precedence over hybrid discovery
